coreMemory.english: v. to have something as part of a whole
coreMemory.structure: include examples /ɪnˈkluːd ɪɡzæmpəlz/（包括例子）；include information about /ɪnˈkluːd ɪnfɚmeɪʃən əbaʊt/（包含有关……的信息）；include someone in /ɪnˈkluːd sʌmwʌn ɪn/（让某人参与……）；price includes tax /praɪs ɪnkludz tæks/（价格含税）
coreMemory.commonError: ❌ can to include → ✅ can include；❌ to includeing → ✅ to include

commonErrors.note: 情态动词 can 后直接接动词原形，不加 to。
不定式 to 后接动词原形；不要把不定式和 -ing 形式混合。

coreMemory.example: The price includes breakfast and Wi-Fi.
